# Dozo

> Dozo is a workspace of always-on AI bots. Bots keep their conversations, memory and routines, do real work on their own computer (a sandboxed machine with a browser, files and a terminal), and ask the person before anything consequential. It is for people and small teams who want AI helpers that stay around and finish tasks instead of answering one prompt at a time.

Dozo is source available: its own files are under the Elastic License 2.0, the code it builds on under Apache-2.0. It is not open source. Self-hosting is free; the licence does not allow offering Dozo to others as a hosted service.

## How it works

- Bots work on a computer: a Team Computer that a Space's bots share, or a computer of a bot's own where the plan allows. You can watch its screen, take control and hand it back.
- A bot asks before it acts on anything that matters. You approve, edit or deny.
- Routines run a bot on a schedule. Bots keep memory between chats.
- A bot can have several chats; you can edit a message or regenerate a reply. Per-bot backup models take over when a model runs out, and a reply from a backup names it.
- Learning from chats is off until you turn it on; every note it keeps is listed and can be undone.
- A bot API, a command-line tool and an MCP endpoint reach your bots from scripts and other tools.
- An account backup is one file locked with a password. An organization can share a skill library and show its logo.
- Every plan uses your own model connection (your key or your subscription); model costs come from there.
- The desktop app can run the server on your own computer, so chats and files are stored there; what is sent to a model goes to the provider you chose (a local model stays on the computer).

## Apps

- Self-hosted: free on your own server.
- Desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux: https://github.com/SSilistre-dev/dozo/releases/latest . It opens the hosted server, your own server, or runs a server on your computer. The macOS build is signed; the Windows and Linux builds are not signed yet.
- Web app: https://app.dozo.bot (sign-up is open)

## Plans (hosted, prices in US dollars as shown on the site)

- Free: $0 a month, no card needed. Bots work on your own computer (no hosted bot computer), 500 MB file storage.
- Premium: $49 a month, or $39 a month billed yearly ($468 a year). One shared computer (a Team Computer) with 2 vCPU and 2 GB RAM, 100 computer hours a month, 2 GB file storage.
- Premium Plus: $99 a month, or $79 a month billed yearly ($948 a year). Up to 3 computers with 4 vCPU and 4 GB RAM each, 200 computer hours a month, 5 GB file storage.
